from.place: Proof, first sentence invoking sk-prop-integral-criterion: comparison of bounded constructible cohomology with stratified perfect models by finite truncation devissage.

title: Completed-constant cohomology and stratified perfect integral models
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and selected uniformizer $\pi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, put $A=\operatorname{ULift}(R)$ and $I=(\operatorname{ULift}(\pi))\subseteq A$, and let $B=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/I^n)_X$ be the actual completed coefficient ring sheaf on the pro-étale site of $X$ [det-prop-integral-criterion-constant-coefficients]. For every $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B))$, the following are equivalent: $K$ has bounded cohomology and each $H^q(K)$ has completed-constant stratified finitely presented local models [def-sfb-completed-constant-stratified]; $K$ has stratified perfect coefficient models [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data].

proof.text: Use integral_coefficient_hypotheses and the general adic criterion to obtain zero, shift, isomorphism and distinguished-triangle closure of adic constructibility.
A completed-constant constructible module in degree zero has a stratified perfect model, hence is adic constructible by the general criterion.

Prove finite devissage by induction on a natural cohomological interval length. The length-zero object is zero. For the successor use the canonical truncation triangle at the top degree; its upper term is a single cohomology module up to shift, and its lower term has smaller interval. Transport constructibility across the canonical homology isomorphisms and apply triangle closure. The private bounded_devissage proof implements this induction without a sorry.

Conversely the general criterion supplies boundedness. Cohomology of each stratified perfect local model is completed-constant constructible by the local cohomology lemma. Assemble these two assertions.

mathlib_searches.query: Over a complete discrete valuation ring bounded constructible cohomology is equivalent to stratified perfect completed coefficient complexes
mathlib_searches.results: BDeRhamPlus, BDeRham, localCohomology.isoSelfLERadical, WittVector.isAdicCompleteIdealSpanP, IsAdicComplete.StrictMono.of_lift, AdicCompletion.piEquivFin, AdicCompletion.map_exact. None supplies a sheaf local-model comparison.

IsAdicComplete.congr_ringEquiv in Mathlib.RingTheory.AdicCompletion.Topology transports adic completeness across ring equivalences. Used in the coefficient specialization, not a substitute for the geometric statements.

Only the defining module and the current criterion occur in the library. The older integralStratifiedPerfectCharacterization has extra dimension and invertibility hypotheses and another coefficient presentation.

theorem integral_completed_constant_iff_stratified_perfect
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (K : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X
      (adicLisseCompletedRing X
        (ProEtale.IntegralConstantCompletion.ideal l E)))) :
    (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded K ∧
      ∀ q : ℤ, IsCompletedConstantStratified X
        (ProEtale.IntegralConstantCompletion.ideal l E)
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)) ↔
      IsSfbStratifiedPerfect X
        (ProEtale.IntegralConstantCompletion.ideal l E) K
